race.comment: BLACKHILL BOY (2) is going better than his form suggests this campaign and should be at his top now. Draws to get all the favours from the inside and looks the main threat to the debutant. PIKLEMEGRANMOTHER (8) last appeared when she finished second over 1550m at this track on May 22. Strips fitter for a trial win and comes here with definite top-three claims. BALLROOM BLAST (7) struggled to make an impression in tough conditions on debut but should be better for that and keeps Crowther in the saddle. PRINCE PRESTIGIOUS (5) failed to get involved on debut in testing conditions but should've come on from that and hails from a sharp stable. Willing to give another look.
